recommendations.Pepper Bell - Bacterial Spot: Spray copper-based bactericides; use pathogen-free seeds.
recommendations.Pepper Bell - Healthy: Plant is healthy! Maintain regular watering and soil nutrition.
recommendations.Potato - Early Blight: Apply protective fungicides (Mancozeb or Chlorothalonil); rotate crops.
recommendations.Potato - Late Blight: Apply copper fungicides or systemic treatments; destroy infected plant debris.
recommendations.Potato - Healthy: Plant is healthy! Maintain proper soil drainage and moisture.
recommendations.Tomato - Bacterial Spot: Use copper-based sprays; avoid overhead irrigation.
recommendations.Tomato - Early Blight: Apply copper or Mancozeb fungicide; prune lower leaves near soil.
recommendations.Tomato - Late Blight: Apply systemic fungicides immediately; remove heavily infected foliage.
recommendations.Tomato - Leaf Mold: Improve greenhouse airflow/ventilation and lower humidity.
recommendations.Tomato - Septoria Leaf Spot: Apply fungicides; remove fallen leaf debris and practice crop rotation.
recommendations.Tomato - Spider Mites (Two-Spotted): Apply insecticidal soap or neem oil; maintain adequate humidity.
recommendations.Tomato - Target Spot: Apply protective fungicides; improve plant spacing for airflow.
recommendations.Tomato - Yellow Leaf Curl Virus: Control whiteflies using yellow sticky traps/neem oil; remove infected plants.
recommendations.Tomato - Mosaic Virus: Disinfect gardening tools and destroy infected plants (no chemical cure).
recommendations.Tomato - Healthy: Plant is healthy! Continue good cultural practices.
